selection: For every default seed, sort spikes per neuron. Exclude stimulated inputs. Find earliest ordinal pair differing by more than 0.0002 ms (two common ticks); rank by earlier physical event, root ID, zero-based ordinal. Preserve absent selections. Ordinal pairing is descriptive, not proof of event identity.
replay: All selected targets from initial rest to one refractory duration after selected pair, common endpoint rounded up to a coarse tick. Original saved incoming histories at both native steps; require every saved target tick to match before fixed-fine-grid comparison. Then use coarse saved incoming history at fine dt, compare with fine history. No network feedback replay.
budget: One worker, 180-second external deadline, no automatic retry. Keep failed/missing native replays and do not interpret their hybrid.
limitations: Exploratory selection beyond one coarse tick is not a scientific tolerance. Short local histories condition on archived network spikes. They do not establish the first network cause, explain full-second count error, demonstrate chaos, or alter convergence criteria.
